# State fixtures

Each directory here, `vX.Y.Z/`, is a state root (what `FASTENER_STATE_DIR`
points at) holding sessions exactly as that release wrote them. The tests load
every session in every directory with the current code, so a newer CLI is
proven to read older on-disk schemas (design §4, Upgrades).

When a release changes a schema (adds or changes a field in `session.json`,
`status.json`, the generation plan or launcher record, or `stop-request.json`),
add a new `vX.Y.Z/` directory generated by that release. Never edit an existing
one.

How `v0.1.0` was made: the `v0.1.0` tag was built and run against the fake
agent (`internal/testbin/fakeagent`) to produce an exited session, a
launch-failed one and one stopped with `SIGKILL`. The files were then
sanitized: fixed timestamps, `/tmp/x` paths, a fixed marker, fixed pids and boot
ID, and no environment from the generating machine. Logs are not kept; the
readers do not parse them.
